name: mindbody-cli
description: Use the Mindbody CLI to manage a user's own gym and studio class bookings: list bookings and waitlist positions, browse the studio schedule, book and cancel classes, join and leave waitlists, and inspect membership passes. Trigger this skill when the user mentions Mindbody, gym or studio class bookings, booking a class, cancelling a class, waitlists, class schedules, membership passes, classId, siteVisitId, or waitlistId.
